title: Trump Urges Swift End to Ukraine Conflict in Reported Dialogue with Putin, Kremlin Says
snippet: According to Kremlin statements, Donald Trump signaled a desire to rapidly conclude the war in Ukraine and work toward restoring diplomatic ties between Washington and Moscow.
content:
In a notable diplomatic development reported by Moscow, Donald Trump conveyed to Russian President Vladimir Putin his ambition to bring a swift conclusion to the war in Ukraine. The exchange highlights a potential shift in how Washington might approach the ongoing Eastern European conflict.

A Push to Restore Bilateral Relations

According to Kremlin officials, the dialogue extended beyond the battlefield to address the broader state of U.S.-Russia relations, which have plummeted to historic lows following the 2022 invasion. Trump reportedly expressed interest in normalizing ties between the two nuclear powers, signaling an emphasis on renewed engagement and direct negotiation.
